The Season of Metal Is HERE 🔩 Metal Sonic Takes Shadow's Throne | Sonic 4 & New Anime

short // Jul 11, 2026 · Updated Sep 24, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Hold up, player. Shadow is the face of the new generation. But without this guy right here, Metal Sonic, Shadow doesn't even exist.

Let me put it on you.

Metal Sonic is the original bloodline

If Metal Sonic was your rival, congrats: you're old school. Metal Sonic showed up in Sonic CD back in 1993, during the whole evil-copy era. He's a robot Eggman built to be everything Sonic is, minus the heart. Same speed, same shape, none of the soul.

That made him Sonic's first true rival, a good eight years before Shadow was even a thought.

Then Sega handed the crown to Shadow

Shadow is the new generation. He showed up in 2001 in Sonic Adventure 2: all edge, guns, the whole vibe. And no shade, but Sega handed him the golden goose:

  • The first solo game, Shadow the Hedgehog, in 2005.
  • The fanbase, and two decades as the face of "mature" Sonic.
  • A whole movie built around him, with Keanu Reeves voicing him in Sonic the Hedgehog 3.

Metal Sonic got boss fights. Great boss fights, but boss fights.

And listen to this: the one time these two actually threw hands, Shadow beat my boy up. So history hasn't been kind to Metal.

2026 flips the whole script

This is the season of the classic generation, and Metal is getting two big moments.

First, he's the main villain of Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond, a new animated short coming this fall. Eggman steals Sonic's life data and the Chaos Emeralds to make Metal Sonic unstoppable.

Second, Sonic the Hedgehog 4. Jeff Fowler has Metal Sonic in the movie, and I'm calling it: he's the final boss.

The OG rival is taking his rightful throne back. Finally.

Why Metal hits different now

Metal Sonic has always been the copy that couldn't close the gap. He had the speed and the strength, but never whatever it is that makes Sonic win anyway. Give him Sonic's actual life data and Chaos Emerald power on top of that, and the gap is gone. You're not fighting a knockoff anymore. You're fighting yourself with the safety off.

Shadow's threat was always emotional: he's the guy who might not save you. Metal's threat is existential: he's the guy who proves you were replaceable.

Update (September 2026)

Here's where both projects stand:

  • Memories and Beyond was revealed at Anime Expo in July with a sneak peek. It's a 10-minute short for Sonic's 35th anniversary, still set for this fall. In the story, Sonic and his friends have to lean on the friendship they built over their adventures to beat the upgraded Metal Sonic.
  • Sonic the Hedgehog 4 wrapped filming in May, and Fowler marked it by sharing a first look at Metal Sonic. The movie hits theaters March 19, 2027.

One correction from when I first posted this: I said Fowler had confirmed Metal as the final boss. What's actually confirmed is that Metal Sonic is in the movie. I couldn't find Fowler or Paramount officially calling him the final boss, so for now that's my call, not a confirmation.

Sources: Anime News Network, Nintendo Wire, Variety, Wikipedia: Sonic the Hedgehog 4)

Quick answers

When did Metal Sonic first appear? In Sonic CD, in 1993.

When did Shadow the Hedgehog first appear? In Sonic Adventure 2, in 2001.

What is Sonic the Hedgehog: Memories and Beyond? A 10-minute animated short for Sonic's 35th anniversary, coming in fall 2026, with Metal Sonic as the main villain.

When does Sonic the Hedgehog 4 come out? March 19, 2027.

Is Metal Sonic in Sonic 4? Yes. Director Jeff Fowler shared a first look at Metal Sonic when filming wrapped in May 2026.

Your turn

Which generation are you: Metal or Shadow? Drop it in the comments. And if you're Team Metal like me, it's our time to shine, baby. 🔩
